title: Recruiting
subtitle: 「招聘／招募」在 HR 語境中不是單一步驟。 要先分清：一般 hiring、完整 recruitment process、整體 staffing、長期 talent acquisi
description: 「招聘／招募」在 HR 語境中不是單一步驟。 要先分清：一般 hiring、完整 recruitment process、整體 staffing、長期 talent acquisition，以及只屬前段的 talent/candidate sourcing。

options.explanation: Hiring ✓ — means finding and taking people on as employees; it often highlights the employment decision more than early candidate attraction. In this sentence, general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring. That makes Hiring the most precise replacement for this particular sense of recruiting.

Recruitment — is the formal noun for the organised process of attracting, assessing and appointing people. It is genuine HR vocabulary, but it does not match the decisive clue here: general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring.

Staffing — means ensuring an organisation has enough appropriate people and can include recruitment, allocation and headcount planning. It is genuine HR vocabulary, but it does not match the decisive clue here: general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring.

Selection — is the stage of choosing among candidates rather than the whole recruitment process. It is genuine HR vocabulary, but it does not match the decisive clue here: general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring.

Onboarding — is the post-hire process of introducing a new employee to the organisation. It is genuine HR vocabulary, but it does not match the decisive clue here: general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring.

Advertising — means publicising vacancies and is only one recruitment channel. It is genuine HR vocabulary, but it does not match the decisive clue here: general employment recruitment including taking people on is naturally expressed as hiring.
